fact_text: S&P upgraded Pakistan's sovereign credit rating one notch to B-, which the guest said should improve investor perception of the country.

fact_text: The IMF set a June 2025 State Bank reserves target of 13.9 billion dollars, which the guest described as aggressive.

fact_text: The government reported reserves of 14.5 billion dollars against the June 2025 IMF target, with the State Bank managing the position despite currency pressure.

fact_text: The IMF reserves target for 2026 is about 17 billion dollars, according to the guest.
